The moment the last ground ropes are loosed, twenty-four hot-air balloons lift together as one fleet, the nearest a vast hot-pink-and-white chevron mass with its bar-and-clip basket corners just clearing the lower edge, a hot-dog-shaped balloon with a curved-slope bun whole and readable in the middle distance, and a field of magenta, lime, hot-pink and vermilion beyond, the farthest as small as a single stud.

A lakeshore launch sends thirty hot-air balloons climbing inland, the nearest baskets riding low over trans-blue water plates, the nearest balloon a vast cobalt-and-hot-pink quartered mass of four solid-colour smooth panels with its bar-and-clip basket corners just clearing the waterline, a sunflower-shaped balloon with a ring of egg-yolk petal plates whole and bright in the middle distance, and twenty more at every height behind, shrinking to bright dots against the sky.

Forty or more hot-air balloons drift in a loose procession over long rows of brick vineyard, each at a different height from basket-rim close to pinprick far, the nearest a vast cyan-and-egg-yolk mass polka-dotted with round tile dots so large its bar-and-clip basket corners crowd the lower edge, a lighthouse-shaped balloon banded red and white with a trans-clear lamp globe whole and readable in the middle distance, and twenty more at every height behind, shrinking to bright dots against the sky.

Thirty-two hot-air balloons lift in a wide spread over an orchard of pink blossom elements, each balloon at its own height from enormous to almost invisible, the nearest a vast tangerine-and-lime mass star-studded with contrasting tile stars so large its basket rim nearly fills the lower edge, a pumpkin-shaped balloon with ribbed orange curved slopes whole and readable in the middle distance, and the rest strung out at every height from basket-rim close to pinprick far.

A launch from a snowfield of white plates doubles every colour in crisp reflection below, thirty-four hot-air balloons rising at every height, the nearest a vast vermilion-and-cobalt zigzag mass of smooth unmarked panels with its bar-and-clip basket corners almost level with the snow surface, a frog-shaped balloon with two bulging dish-element eyes whole and readable in the middle distance, and a field of magenta, lime, hot-pink and vermilion beyond, the farthest as small as a single stud.

At dusk, thirty-odd hot-air balloons descend toward a lit landing field, their trans-orange flame elements flaring one by one as each basket drops lower, the nearest a vast hot-pink-and-lime crown-to-skirt gradient in stepped brick rows so large its chrome burner cylinder nearly fills the upper edge, a ladybird-shaped balloon with red smooth unmarked panels and black round-tile spots whole and readable in the middle distance, and a dozen tiny ones still high and small above the middle distance, glowing warm against the deepening sky.

On a cold morning, thirty-odd hot-air balloons hang at every height, most still pale and slack across the grass while six stand fully taut and blazing, the nearest a vast cyan-and-white harlequin-diamond mass so close its chrome burner cylinder grazes the upper edge, a pumpkin-shaped balloon with ribbed orange curved slopes whole and readable in the middle distance, and the far ones reduced to bright round specks over the treeline.

Just after rain, twenty-four hot-air balloons launch doubled in long trans-clear puddle plates below, the nearest a vast egg-yolk-and-magenta balloon dotted across every panel with round tile dots cropped hard by the left edge, its bar-and-clip basket corners shining above the wet plates, a ladybird-shaped balloon with red smooth panels and black round-tile spots whole in the middle distance, and twenty more at every height behind, shrinking to bright dots against the sky.

Thirty-two hot-air balloons lift while chase-crew minifigures run beneath with trailing ropes at every angle, the nearest a vast egg-yolk-and-cobalt chevron mass filling the lower right, its basket bar-and-clip corners almost level with the frame edge, a mushroom-shaped balloon with a rounded cap perfectly readable in the middle distance, and a scatter of cobalt and egg-yolk chequerboards climbing to tiny specks near the top of the frame.

A launch just after rain doubles thirty-two hot-air balloons in long trans-clear puddle plates below, the nearest a hot-pink-and-white polka-dotted mass tiled with round tile dots and cropped by the left and lower frame edges, a lighthouse-shaped balloon banded red and white with a trans-clear lamp whole and readable in the middle distance, and the far ones reduced to bright round specks over the treeline.

A mass ascension of thirty-eight hot-air balloons, every one lifting at once in a single great surge, the nearest a vast vermilion-and-white chequerboard mass cropped by the top edge with its bar-and-clip basket rim close to the lower corner, a chess-knight balloon in white smooth panels with a curved-slope mane whole and readable in the middle distance, and the rest strung out at every height from basket-rim close to pinprick far.

A lakeshore launch of thirty-odd hot-air balloons, the nearest baskets already over the trans-blue water plates while the fleet climbs inland at every height, the nearest a vast tangerine-and-cobalt harlequin diamond mass so wide its chrome burner cylinder barely clears the lower edge, a cupcake-shaped balloon with a domed curved-slope frosting top whole and readable in the middle distance, and a dozen tiny ones high and small above, each a bright fleck against the pale sky.

Forty or more hot-air balloons hang over a frozen lake, every envelope doubled clean in the trans-blue plate ice below, the nearest a vast lime-and-vermilion star-studded mass of contrasting tile stars cropped by the left and lower edges with its bar-and-clip basket corners just above the mirrored surface, a castle-turret-shaped balloon with crenellated curved-slope battlements whole in the middle distance, and twenty more at every height behind, shrinking to bright dots against the sky.

A competition launch sends thirty-eight hot-air balloons up from all round the field at every height simultaneously, the nearest a vast vermilion-and-white sunburst-ray mass radiating from the crown, its bar-and-clip basket corners just inside the lower edge, an owl-shaped balloon with two big dish-element eyes whole and readable in the middle distance, and the rest strung out at every height from basket-rim close to pinprick far, every smooth unmarked panel bright against the open sky.

At dusk, thirty-odd hot-air balloons glow lantern-lit from inside by their trans-orange burner flames, each saturated hue pushing outward through the smooth unmarked brick panels, the nearest a vast cobalt-and-hot-pink spiral mass filling the right side of the frame its bar-and-clip basket corners near the lower edge, a parrot-shaped balloon in lime, cobalt and vermilion with a curved-slope beak whole and vivid in the middle distance, and a dozen tiny ones high and small above, warm glowing dots against the deepening sky.

At dusk, twenty-eight hot-air balloons glow lantern-lit from inside by trans-orange burner flames, each smooth unmarked brick panel lit a different saturated hue, the nearest a vast lime-and-white zigzag panel mass with its chrome burner cylinder blazing at the upper edge, a crescent-moon balloon in pale egg-yolk with a curved-slope face whole and readable in the middle distance, and a field of magenta, lime, hot-pink and vermilion beyond, the farthest as small as a single stud.

Twenty-eight hot-air balloons rise out of a red-rock canyon past the rim at every height, the nearest a vast hot-pink-and-lime chequerboard mass with its basket rim just clearing the canyon edge, a cactus-shaped balloon in lime with plate spines whole and readable in the middle distance, and twenty more at every height behind, shrinking to bright dots against the sky.

A staggered launch of thirty-odd hot-air balloons, a dozen already high and small while the rest still swell on the grass as long loose coloured sleeves, the nearest a vast tangerine-and-cobalt quartered mass cropped by the right and lower edges with its bar-and-clip basket corners just visible, a cat-shaped balloon with two pointed slope ears whole and readable in the middle distance, and the far ones reduced to bright round specks over the treeline.

The moment the last ground ropes are loosed, thirty-five hot-air balloons lift together in one great simultaneous rise, the nearest a vast cyan-and-white zigzag-panelled mass cropped at the top and right edges with its bar-and-clip basket rim just clearing the lower edge, a teapot-shaped balloon with a curved-slope spout and handle whole and readable in the middle distance, and the far ones reduced to bright round specks over the treeline.

A launch of twenty-four hot-air balloons from a narrow alpine valley between brick pasture and white cloud-slope peaks, the nearest a vast cyan-and-white smooth unmarked mass patterned with round tile polka dots so large its chrome burner cylinder clips the lower edge of the frame, a snail-shaped balloon with a coiled curved-slope shell whole and readable in the middle distance, and a dozen tiny ones high and small above the middle distance, bright against the white peaks.

Thirty-odd hot-air balloons launch from a clifftop meadow and drift out over the trans-blue water plates below, the nearest a vast hot-pink-and-lime chevron mass of stacked brick rows cropped by the frame with its bar-and-clip basket rim near the lower edge, a strawberry-shaped balloon with a green leaf-plate calyx whole and readable in the middle distance, and the far ones reduced to bright round specks over the treeline at the cliff edge.

At dawn, twenty-six hot-air balloons launch shin-deep in trans-white mist plates, the nearest a vast tangerine-and-cobalt gore-striped mass of alternating vertical smooth unmarked panels with its chrome burner cylinder catching the early light just above the mist surface, a sunflower-shaped balloon with a full ring of egg-yolk petal plates whole and readable in the middle distance, and the far ones already reduced to bright round specks drifting over the treeline.

A wind fanning forty or more hot-air balloons across the full width of the sky at every height, the nearest a vermilion-and-white sunburst ray mass radiating from the crown so large its chrome burner cylinder grazes the lower edge of the frame, a turtle-shaped balloon with a domed plate shell whole and readable in the middle distance, and a field of magenta, lime, hot-pink and vermilion beyond, the farthest as small as a single stud.

Forty or more hot-air balloons drift so low the nearest baskets skim the treeline, the closest a vast lime-and-vermilion harlequin diamond mass of smooth unmarked panels cropped by the lower edge with its bar-and-clip basket corners level with the highest branches, a dragon-head balloon with a vermilion curved-slope snout whole and readable in the middle distance, and a field of magenta, lime, hot-pink and vermilion beyond, the farthest reduced to a single stud of colour.

Half of thirty-six hot-air balloons lie flat on the grass as long slack coloured sleeves while the rest stand fully taut behind them, the nearest an enormous lime-and-white sunburst-ray mass cropped by the top edge with its chrome burner cylinder near the upper frame, an ice-cream-cone balloon with a scoop of curved slopes on a tan wedge whole and readable in the middle distance, and a scatter of cobalt and egg-yolk chequerboards climbing to tiny specks near the top of the frame.

The fleet fanning out across a wide valley at wildly different heights, twenty-four hot-air balloons spread from basket-close to pinprick small, the nearest a hot-pink-and-lime star-studded mass with contrasting tile stars across every smooth unmarked brick panel cropped at the left edge, a rocket-shaped balloon with a pointed slope nose cone whole and readable in the middle distance, and a scatter of cobalt and egg-yolk chequerboards climbing to tiny specks near the top of the frame.

Against a cobalt night sky, forty or more hot-air balloons glow lit from within by their trans-orange flame elements, each chrome burner cylinder casting saturated colour outward through smooth unmarked brick panels, the nearest a vast lime-and-vermilion polka-dotted mass of round tile dots cropped by the left and lower edges, a koala-shaped balloon with round grey dish-element ears whole and readable in the middle distance, the rest strung out at every height from basket-rim close to pinprick far.

Thirty-two hot-air balloons string out over rolling green downs all the way to the horizon at every height, the nearest a vast vermilion-and-cobalt harlequin diamond mass cropped by the left and lower edges with its bar-and-clip basket corners just above the plate-mosaic grass, a submarine-shaped balloon with a smooth dish-element porthole whole and readable in the middle distance, and a scatter of cobalt and egg-yolk chequerboards climbing through every height to tiny specks near the top of the frame.

A fleet of thirty-two hot-air balloons descends at dusk toward a lit landing field, burners flaring one by one in bright trans-orange pulses, the nearest a vast vermilion-and-cobalt crown-to-skirt gradient in stepped brick rows so large its basket rim nearly fills the lower edge, a dinosaur-shaped balloon with a row of plate spines down its back whole and readable in the middle distance, a dozen tiny ones high and small above the middle distance glowing tangerine and lime against the deepening sky.

A launch of twenty-four hot-air balloons rises in a narrow alpine valley between brick pasture plates and white cloud-slope peaks, the nearest a vast cyan-and-egg-yolk zigzag-panelled mass so large its chrome burner cylinder nearly clips the upper edge, a cactus-shaped balloon in lime with plate spines whole and readable in the middle distance, the far ones reduced to bright round specks over the treeline, every balloon climbing at a different height between the valley walls.
